content.short: Gaming, Poker, Fun, Community and Staking for Web3.
content.description:
The Cardano Crocs Club (CCC) is a Cardano-based NFT gaming ecosystem built around community and strong values. Here at CCC, we are all Crocs − we love our swamp, believe in Web3, and create utility to provide opportunities for our holders.

CCC is open to the world of NFTs and partnerships and is striving to build what we call home: the Swamp, a common-ground where other projects and Web3 developers can grow together.
